sections.heading: Fire sprinkler water damage cleanup involving kitchen pantry shelving and cabinet toe by tiled backsplash
paragraphs: The kitchen response separates swollen pantry-shelf edges from detachable cabinet toe material and from the tiled backsplash that may be retained. Cabinet installation depends on the exposed support and wall-edge observations, while hidden areas behind fixed backsplash remain outside the inspected boundary.

sections.heading: Fire sprinkler water damage cleanup involving garage storage shelving, gypsum base and concrete floor
paragraphs: Garage-storage work separates paper-faced gypsum board from cardboard containers and fixed wood shelving, since each belongs to a different disposition decision. We collect affected building-board pieces from the approved wall opening and evaluate shelf contact at its support points; an intact shelf face does not show whether its wall-side joint held water. Retained concrete and reachable shelf supports receive their specified cleaning before replacement board covers those contact points, with exposed framing tracked independently during drying. Boxes and stored belongings remain with the client-directed contents plan, and a wall span still blocked by shelving stays listed as unexamined rather than receiving the result from the open alcove.
